title: Diversity and Language Technology: How Techno-Linguistic Bias Can Cause Epistemic Injustice
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Its analysis centers on linguistic and cultural biases inherent in the design of language technologies, rather than religious biases.

measurement_description: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement related to faith or religion. Its focus is on techno-linguistic bias, analyzing how language technologies designed primarily for English fail to represent concepts from other languages and cultures, leading to epistemic injustice. The examples provided relate to kinship, food, and time, not religion.
